contract.scope: Phase7 startup configuration safety and parallel-test isolation
contract.holdout: Each of seven required variables must reject empty and whitespace-only values (14 cases); Debug must redact the API key (1 case)
contract.anchor: Valid complete configuration succeeds; wrong nonempty phase/layer and each missing variable fail (10 native process cases); all14 Node tests retained
contract.measurement: Build the identical probe against each real production module, execute each configuration in a separate process with an explicit synthetic environment. No mock module, live credentials, RuVector availability or persistence claim.
contract.candidateAcceptance: 15/15 holdouts;10/10 native anchors;14/14 Node tests; default-parallel full locked Rust suite passes; repeated Phase7 tests pass without process-global environment mutation or serializing tests
contract.wholeRepositoryMerge: Strict Clippy, formatting, locked build/tests, security/audit and all required CI/approvals must pass. No suppression, threshold reduction, test skipping, --test-threads=1 workaround or force push.
contract.architecture: Rust core/TypeScript integration retained; stateless environment-configured GCP services; no persistence, IAM, schema or deployment changes
